headline: Both conference leaders beaten on the same night
dek: Molloy went down at American International and St. Thomas Aquinas at Southern Connecticut on the same evening, neither side scoring. Both remain unbeaten in conference play and level at the top, but Molloy have now lost twice this season and conceded seven goals.
displaced_by: Molloy and St. Thomas Aquinas both lost away without scoring on 2026-09-29; the standing dek's five-conceded, one-defeat line for Molloy is no longer true
